title: Copy Meets Drop
goal: Resolve compiler conflicts between Copy derivations and Drop implementations.
hints: `Copy` values undergo bitwise copying without tracking ownership.
Remove `Copy` so the type relies on move semantics and explicit `Drop`.
explanation: `Copy` and `Drop` are mutually exclusive in Rust. Deriving `Copy` causes error `E0184` because bitwise copying leaves no owner boundary to run destructors deterministically. Removing `Copy` while keeping `Clone` allows the compiler to manage moves and execute `Drop` correctly.
